nodes.label: Sentinel Agent
nodes.author: Anirban Sarkar
nodes.rationale: Single-user, approval-gated investment intelligence agent: no existing tool aggregates Zerodha + INDmoney + Fidelity + EPF into one policy-bound view, and the owner wants every action human-approved and later scored.

nodes.label: Investment Policy Statement (IPS)
nodes.rationale: Binding, versioned document so every recommendation must cite a clause; changes require owner action outside a drawdown plus 48h cooling-off, which prevents the policy being rewritten under emotional stress.

nodes.label: Objective Function (risk-adjusted return under 30% drawdown)
nodes.rationale: Maximize risk-adjusted return subject to a hard 30% max drawdown; the 30% number comes from the owner's revealed tolerance rather than a questionnaire.

nodes.label: No-Catch-Up Rule
nodes.rationale: Funded-status is unreadable by any sizing or risk function, enforced as a code-level property, because a shortfall must never justify taking more risk to catch up.

nodes.label: Funded Status vs FI Band
nodes.rationale: Reporting-only metric computed monthly against the ₹10.3–17.1 Cr real FI band.

nodes.label: Strategic Asset Allocation
nodes.rationale: Equity ceiling ~60% calibrated so a 2008-grade crash lands at roughly −25 to −30% portfolio drawdown, matching the stated tolerance; gold 5–10%; EPF counts as debt-like.

nodes.label: Cash Ceiling (≤10% idle cash)
nodes.rationale: Measured on bank balances less the funded B3 balance only — the B3 target is never excused — because idle cash above the ceiling is uninvested capital, while an unfunded emergency target is not yet cash set aside.

nodes.label: Core-Satellite 75/25 Equity Structure
nodes.rationale: ≥75% of equity flows go to index instruments; the ≤25% satellite sleeve is where agent stock-picking skill is bounded and measurable, so a bad sleeve cannot sink the plan.

nodes.label: Hard Concentration Caps
nodes.rationale: ≤10% single stock/issuer, ≤35% single MF scheme, ≤25% sector, ≤10% employer stock (NOW) — the NOW cap exists because salary, RSUs and group insurance are all the same employer.

nodes.label: Credit Rule (beat 7.95% loan rate)
nodes.rationale: Slab-taxed credit paper must beat the highest loan rate after tax and a credit-risk haircut; the new tax regime gives no home-loan interest deduction, which strengthens prepay-vs-invest math.

nodes.label: Legacy Cleanup Mandate
nodes.rationale: All four smallcase subscriptions terminated at v1 while their constituent ETFs are retained; consolidation is spread over 1–2 fiscal years to fit inside the ₹1.25L LTCG exemption instead of triggering a single large tax event.

nodes.label: Behavioral Pre-Commitment Protocol
nodes.rationale: At −20% drawdown the agent replays the owner's own written policy and 2022 history and demands a typed reason before any pause — designed around the finding that the 2022 SIP pause was a liquidity crisis, not fear.

nodes.label: Bucket B1: FI Corpus
nodes.rationale: ₹10.3–17.1 Cr real at age 55, derived from ₹3–5L/month FI income at a 3.5% SWR; the owner's original ₹40 Cr anchor was discarded as unexamined arithmetic.

nodes.label: Bucket B2: House Fund
nodes.rationale: Hyderabad home 2033–35; 100% capital-preservation once seeded — no equity risk on money needed within 7 years of purchase.

nodes.label: Bucket B3: Emergency Fund
nodes.rationale: ₹6L liquid, funded by the Sammaan Sep-2026 maturity plus the Nov-2026 vest; it is the structural fix for the 2022 liquidity crisis that caused the SIP pause. Split across banks beyond ₹5L for DICGC cover.

nodes.label: Bucket B4: Education Corpus
nodes.rationale: ₹1 Cr in today's money at child's age 18 (~2046); activates ~2028 with a long-horizon equity glide path de-risking from ~2040.

nodes.label: Milestone M1: Term Life Cover
nodes.rationale: ₹2 Cr personal term cover before the child arrives; employer group cover evaporates on exit and the maximum-dependency point is now, so the agent nags until it is done.

nodes.label: Milestone M2: Health Super Top-Up
nodes.rationale: ~₹50L family super top-up beyond employer cover, same nag mechanics as M1.

nodes.label: ServiceNow RSU Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Modelled from a seeded grant table because no Fidelity retail API exists; base case includes $20k/yr refreshers with a no-refresher downside scenario maintained alongside.

nodes.label: Loan Prepayment Cascade
nodes.rationale: Owner-locked strategy: car loan 1 EMI redirects to car loan 2 then to the home loan, closing it Dec 2033 and saving ~₹19.3L interest. Loan outflow is constant ₹55,526/mo until Dec 2033, a step function the contribution model must encode.

nodes.label: Investable Surplus Curve
nodes.rationale: ~₹76k/month with a 10% annual step-up, modelled as flat → minus child dent (2028) → plus loan release (2034) → rent-to-EMI conversion at Hyderabad purchase.

nodes.label: Telegram Approval Workflow
nodes.rationale: Approve / Modify / Defer / Reject / Show alternates on inline buttons; the human gate is the primary containment for LLM error, so there are no standing auto-execute rules.

nodes.label: Approval State Machine
nodes.rationale: DRAFT → PENDING_APPROVAL → APPROVED/MODIFIED/DEFERRED/REJECTED/EXPIRED, then AWAITING_SESSION → EXECUTING → fills, with a separate advisory path ending in VERIFIED or ABANDONED.

nodes.label: Safety Rails Engine
nodes.rationale: Rails live in settings_rails and are enforced pre-draft in deterministic code, never LLM-evaluated; a draft violating a rail cannot exist. Edits cool for 48h and loosening is refused outright above 15% drawdown.

nodes.label: /freeze Kill Switch
nodes.rationale: One Telegram command cancels all pending approvals and halts drafting; notifications continue during freeze so the owner is never blinded by the safety action itself.

nodes.label: Falsification Circuit Breaker
nodes.rationale: Three consecutive approved recommendations hitting their falsification conditions self-demote the agent to report-only; reset requires an explicit owner command plus an agent-generated post-mortem.

nodes.label: Staleness Engine
nodes.rationale: Every datum carries as_of + source; prices 24h, NAVs 48h, fundamentals 1 quarter, FX 48h, syncs 36h. Violations block recommendations loudly — free-data fragility is mitigated by guaranteeing loud failure rather than silent degradation.

nodes.label: Satellite Stock Signal Stack
nodes.rationale: Composite 0–100 with valuation 30%, trend 30%, earnings direction 20%, fit 20%; score ≥70 required. Trend is weighted heavily specifically so the system never buys quality in freefall.

nodes.label: Binary Quality Gate
nodes.rationale: ROCE >15%, positive FCF in 4 of 5 years, sane D/E, zero red flags (pledging >5%, auditor resignation, SEBI action) — must-pass before any score matters.

nodes.label: Mutual Fund Switch Signal Stack
nodes.rationale: Ranked on rolling-return consistency percentiles rather than point returns, plus expense ratio, manager tenure, AUM bloat and style drift; a switch must clear exit load, tax impact and estimated switch cost.

nodes.label: Allocation / Drift Engine
nodes.rationale: Hybrid rebalancing: annual April calendar rebalance plus monthly ±5% drift bands; a band breach generates a recommendation, never an auto-trade, and prefers directing new flows over selling for tax reasons.

nodes.label: Sell / Exit Triggers
nodes.rationale: Seven monthly-evaluated triggers; sell logic is first-class because the system must be demonstrably capable of recommending exits, not only entries.

nodes.label: Alternate Generation (primary + 2)
nodes.rationale: Alternate 1 = same intent different instrument, Alternate 2 = different intent (including do-nothing or debt prepayment), so the owner always sees a real choice set rather than a single take-it-or-leave-it action.

nodes.label: LLM Narrates, Code Decides
nodes.rationale: Deterministic code computes all scores, caps, taxes and screens; the LLM may never originate a number that feeds a rail or a score. LLM error is contained by construction plus the human approval gate.

nodes.label: Tax Engine
nodes.rationale: All rates parameterized in config and verified at build time, never hardcoded in logic; the engine states it computes estimates, not filings, since the audience is ClearTax self-filing.

nodes.label: FIFO Lot Tracking
nodes.rationale: FIFO lots everywhere including seeded history; corporate actions adjust lots and every sell shows per-lot gains.

nodes.label: LTCG Harvest Planner
nodes.rationale: Proposes harvest transactions each fiscal year to consume the ₹1.25L equity LTCG exemption against the cleanup program.

nodes.label: Schedule FA / ClearTax Exports
nodes.rationale: Holding US-listed shares at Fidelity makes Schedule FA reporting applicable today, so foreign holdings need acquisition/peak/closing INR values exported annually.

nodes.label: Paper Mode
nodes.rationale: A global flag under which the full pipeline runs, recommendations are scored, and execution is structurally impossible; 4 weeks minimum before any live drafting.

nodes.label: Recommendation Scorecard
nodes.rationale: Benchmark is stored at creation time so scoring cannot be retrofitted; scoring at 3/6/12 months also measures whether owner modifications and rejections added or subtracted value.

nodes.label: Conviction Calibration
nodes.rationale: HIGH conviction must outperform MEDIUM over trailing 12 months or the conviction model is flagged; systematic overconfidence is itself a breaker-review trigger.

nodes.label: Satellite Demotion Rule
nodes.rationale: Satellite sleeve underperforming its benchmark by >3% annualized over any rolling 12 months freezes the sleeve to index-only pending an owner-reviewed post-mortem.

nodes.label: Shutdown Criterion
nodes.rationale: An advisory agent that cannot beat 'index the core, prepay debt, do nothing else' after 24 months of scored operation should be simplified back to that baseline — the product is allowed to conclude it is unnecessary.

nodes.label: Supabase Storage Schema
nodes.rationale: Minimum table set spanning snapshots, lots, recommendations, approvals, orders, scores, incidents, settings_rails and audit_log; free-tier pause risk mitigated by daily cron writes plus a weekly keep-alive ping.

nodes.label: Audit Immutability
nodes.rationale: Append-only tables with RLS denying update/delete; nothing is ever hard-deleted, so every state transition remains reconstructible after the fact.

nodes.label: Zerodha Kite Connect Integration
nodes.rationale: Personal tier chosen because it is free and gives orders, GTT and Coin MF orders; it provides no market data, so prices come from NSE bhavcopy instead.

nodes.label: Human-in-Loop Session Unlock
nodes.rationale: Kite access tokens expire daily; the owner completes OAuth+TOTP on phone per session. Storing no broker password or TOTP secret is the security model, not a limitation.

nodes.label: Kite Deep-Link Bridge
nodes.rationale: NSE's retail algo framework requires a registered static IP for API placement; opening a pre-filled order in the Kite app for one-tap placement is zero-infra, compliant and adequate at ≤4 actions/month, keeping static-IP friction off the critical path.

nodes.label: Order Idempotency Tags
nodes.rationale: Every order carries a UUID tag checked before placement and reused on retry, so replaying the same approval can never produce two broker orders.

nodes.label: INDmoney Advisory-Only Path
nodes.rationale: No public order-placement API exists, so actions are instruct → owner executes in-app → verify on next sync → nag at T+2/T+7. The asymmetry is designed for explicitly; INDmoney actions are never presented as executable.

nodes.label: Fidelity RSU Modelled Integration
nodes.rationale: No retail API, so vests stay PROJECTED until a quarterly owner reconciliation turns them ACTUAL; vested NOW is the largest single-stock position and is invisible to every other tool the owner has.

nodes.label: Telegram Bot Channel
nodes.rationale: Free Bot API is the primary interaction surface; the bot is locked to the owner's chat ID and ignores every other ID.

nodes.label: Sole-User / SEBI RIA Boundary
nodes.rationale: SEBI Registered Investment Adviser regulation and the whole liability posture change the moment a second person receives the output as advice, so the builder must not add features easing recommendation sharing; a second user requires RIA analysis before a single line of code.

nodes.label: Never-Events (F&O, intraday, leverage, LAS)
nodes.rationale: Implemented as absent code paths rather than disabled features, with no override path in software, so a future moment of weakness cannot toggle them on.

nodes.label: Kolkata Flat Exclusion
nodes.rationale: Non-negotiable family asset housing the owner's parents at ₹0 yield; never an optimization target, never a sale or rent candidate.

nodes.label: 30% Maximum Drawdown Constraint
nodes.rationale: Revealed rather than questionnaire-derived tolerance; it is the binding constraint that sets the ~60% equity ceiling.

nodes.label: PRD Phase 2 — Prove
nodes.rationale: DoD: 4 clean weeks of paper operation, ≥5 end-to-end owner approval interactions, a rendering scorecard, and a simulated rail violation plus breaker trip both behaving to spec.

nodes.label: PRD Phase 3 — Act
nodes.rationale: Gated on owner review of the paper scorecard; introduces real Kite execution, tax engine v1 and armed caps/breakers.

nodes.label: Zero-Cost Data Budget
nodes.rationale: Total data cost is ₹0 in v1; the accepted consequence is fundamental coverage limited to the ~40-name watchlist, with full-market screening deferred 2–3 years until a paid feed is justified.

nodes.label: Quarterly screener.in CSV Upload
nodes.rationale: A 10-minute owner task replaces a paid fundamentals feed; it is the only source for the quality gate inputs.
